name: American Red CrossHQ
mission: Since its founding in 1881 by visionary leader Clara Barton, the American Red Cross has been the nation's premier emergency response organization. We bring shelter, food and comfort to those affected by disasters, large and small. We collect lifesaving donated blood and supply it to patients in need. We provide support to our men and women in military bases around the world, and to the families they leave behind. We train communities in CPR, first aid and other skills that save lives. And we assist our neighbors abroad with critical disaster response, preparedness and disease prevention efforts. We are able to do all this by mobilizing the power of volunteers and the generosity of donors.
theoryOfChange: Mobilizing volunteers and donors to provide immediate relief and training to build resilient communities.

strengths_deep_dive: The American Red Cross demonstrates high-tier financial management, particularly in its ability to maintain a <cite id="1">90.8% program expense ratio</cite> despite its multi-billion dollar scale. This efficiency is paired with a <cite id="1">perfect 93/100 score in Accountability & Finance</cite> from Charity Navigator, reflecting strong internal controls and transparency. Furthermore, the organization has shown consistent growth with a <cite id="7">3-year revenue CAGR of 9.3%</cite>, indicating a stable and expanding donor base that supports its long-term disaster response capabilities.
rich_narrative.summary: The American Red Cross is a massive humanitarian institution that <cite id="4">was founded in 1881</cite> to provide emergency assistance and disaster relief. The organization operates at a significant scale, reporting <cite id="7">$3,804,377,344 in total revenue in FY2024</cite>. Its work is divided into five key areas: disaster relief, biomedical services, training services, service to the armed forces, and international services. A major portion of its operations involves the blood supply, where it <cite id="7">delivered 6.5 million blood products</cite> to patients in need. During times of crisis, the charity provides immediate physical support, such as the <cite id="7">274,000 overnight stays provided</cite> in FY2024 for those displaced by disasters. While the organization has a global reputation, its financial footprint is heavily domestic, with <cite id="6">$597,241,647 in grants to domestic individuals</cite> compared to <cite id="6">$61,439,558 for foreign assistance</cite>. This focus on U.S. operations is a key consideration for donors interested in international relief. The charity maintains high operational standards, evidenced by its <cite id="1">93/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> and its status as a <cite id="1">Platinum Seal holder from Candid</cite>.
